rounds.text: The business demonstrates a powerful operational turnaround, highlighted by a remarkable net profit surge of 2650% year-on-year and a quarterly operating margin reaching 20% in September 2026, which represents a strong 10 percentage point expansion over the year-ago quarter [E25, E58]. Investor confidence and corporate stability are heavily underscored by an extraordinary increase in promoter shareholding, surging by 74.95 percentage points to reach 74.96% by September 2026 [E35]. Valuation metrics on a relative basis look highly attractive, with the P/E ratio trading in line with the sector benchmark at 17.88x, an EV/EBITDA of 9.15x comparing favorably to the 9.95x sector benchmark, and a return on capital employed of 10.68% comfortably outperforming the sector median of 6.92% [E6, E10, E11, E67]. Market momentum further validates the underlying strength, evidenced by a robust 3-year compounded share price growth of 415% alongside a solid 12-month price return of 37.4% [E20, E44]. Conceded: [E37, E38, E61] DCF valuation models indicate the share is overvalued with a negative margin of safety.

The valuation of Ujaas Energy Ltd is detached from the underlying fundamentals, trading at an extreme P/E ratio of 138x and a staggering price-to-book multiple of 100.58x [E1, E2]. This expensive entry point is compounded by a DCF model indicating intrinsic value of ₹34 per share against a market price of ₹172, resulting in a severe negative margin of safety of -412.1% [E37, E38]. Furthermore, the company's reverse DCF reveals that the current share price aggressively prices in 35.0% earnings growth, vastly outstripping the 12.0% baseline expectation [E39]. Operational execution also shows vulnerability, highlighted by a declining yearly operating margin trend over the last four years, high debtor days of 201, and rising working capital days [E26, E54, E55]. The stock bears immense downside risk, underscored by a historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -99.9% and an annualized volatility of 103.5% [E45, E46]. Conceded: promoters hold 74.96% as of Sep 2026, and quarterly operating margin expanded to 20% in Sep 2026 [E25, E35].

Conceded: the DCF model indicates an intrinsic value of ₹34 against a market price of ₹172 [E37]. However, the extreme backward-looking multiples overlook the company's active operational turnaround, which features a quarterly operating margin expanding to 20% in September 2026 compared to 11% in the year-ago quarter [E25] and a net profit surge of 2650% year-on-year [E58]. Furthermore, relative sector data demonstrates that the company trades at a reasonable P/E of 17.88x matching its sector benchmark, alongside an EV/EBITDA of 9.15x that actually undercuts the sector benchmark of 9.95x [E6, E11]. Conceded: the yearly operating margin trend has decreased over the last four years [E26] and debtor days are high [E54]. Despite those headwinds, management alignment is exceptionally strong, with promoters dramatically increasing their holding to 74.96% as of September 2026 from just 0.01% in December 2023 [E35].
